events.name: San Antonio Spurs at Utah Jazz

headlines.description: — Devin Vassell scored 31 points, Victor Wembanyama had 19 points and five blocks and the San Antonio Spurs ran past the Utah Jazz 118-111 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Vassell scores 31 and Wembanyama has 19 points and 5 blocks to lead Spurs past Jazz 118-111

headlines.description: — Kevin Durant had 30 points, 13 rebounds and five blocks and the Phoenix Suns won in Denver for the second time this month, beating the defending champion Nuggets 104-97 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kevin Durant scores 30 points to lead Suns to another win in Denver, 104-97

headlines.description: — After lapping the field in the Eastern Conference, the Boston Celtics have the luxury of using the homestretch of the regular season to prepare for the playoffs.
headlines.shortLinkText: Murray scores career-high 44 points, makes game-winning shot in OT as Hawks outlast Celtics 123-122

events.name: Milwaukee Bucks at New Orleans Pelicans

headlines.description: — Zion Williamson took a more assertive approach to the final minutes of a close game and it paid off for the New Orleans Pelicans.
headlines.shortLinkText: Zion Williamson scores 28, closes out Pelicans' 107-100 win over the Bucks

events.name: Golden State Warriors at Charlotte Hornets

headlines.description: — Stephen Curry scored 23 points with four 3-pointers in his annual homecoming game and the Golden State Warriors beat the Charlotte Hornets 115-97 on Friday night for their third straight win.
headlines.shortLinkText: Stephen Curry returns home, scores 23 points to lead Warriors past Hornets 115-97

events.name: Los Angeles Lakers at Indiana Pacers

headlines.description: — Coach Rick Carlisle believes his Indiana Pacers are already in playoff mode.
headlines.shortLinkText: Pascal Siakam, Tyrese Haliburton combine for 43 points to lead Pacers past Lakers 109-90

headlines.description: — Kawhi Leonard and Paul George hit decisive jump shots in the final seconds for the Los Angeles Clippers, the Orlando Magic did not, and LA won for the fifth time in six road games, 100-97 on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kawhi Leonard scores 29 to lead Clippers past Magic 100-97

headlines.description: — Cade Cunningham scored 33 points, Jalen Duren had 20 points and 18 rebounds and the Detroit Pistons snapped an eight-game losing streak with a 96-87 victory over the Washington Wizards on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Pistons snap 8-game skid, beating the Wizards 96-87 in a matchup of the NBA's bottom 2 teams

headlines.description: — Dennis Schroder and Mikal Bridges each made seven 3-pointers, and the Brooklyn Nets tied an NBA record by making 18 3s in the second half of their 125-108 victory over the Chicago Bulls on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Nets tie NBA record with 18 3-pointers in a half, beat Bulls 125-108

headlines.description: — Donovan Mitchell looked different wearing a protective mask. With the All-Star guard finally back, so did the Cavaliers.
headlines.shortLinkText: Donovan Mitchell returns from injury, Mobley hits late 3-pointers as Cavaliers edge 76ers 117-114

events.name: Portland Trail Blazers at Miami Heat

headlines.description: — Bam Adebayo had 21 points, 11 rebounds and nine assists and the Miami Heat had the largest margin of victory in team history, routing the Portland Trail Blazers 142-82 on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Heat rout Trail Blazers 142-82 for largest margin of victory in team history

events.name: Phoenix Suns at Oklahoma City Thunder

headlines.description: — Oklahoma City's No. 4 scorer has been playing more like a first option lately.
headlines.shortLinkText: Josh Giddey scores 23 points, Thunder rout Suns 128-103 without Gilgeous-Alexander

events.name: New York Knicks at San Antonio Spurs

headlines.description: — Victor Wembanyama had a career-high 40 points and added 20 rebounds and seven assists, and the San Antonio Spurs overcame Jalen Brunson’s career-best 61 points to beat the New York Knicks 130-126 in overtime on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Wembanyama has 40 points, 20 rebounds, Spurs overcome Brunson's 61 points to edge Knicks in OT

headlines.description: — This is why Glen Taylor doesn't want to let go of the Minnesota Timberwolves.
headlines.shortLinkText: Conley, Edwards lead surging Timberwolves past Nuggets 111-98 and into 1st-place tie in West

headlines.description: — Jalen Green scored 30 of his 34 points in the second half and had nine rebounds as the Houston Rockets beat the Utah Jazz 101-100 on Friday night for their 11th straight win.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jalen Green scores 34, leads Rockets to 11th straight win with 101-100 victory over Jazz

headlines.description: — Dante Exum hit the winning 3-pointer with 27.5 seconds to go, Kyrie Irving had 30 points and the Dallas Mavericks beat the Sacramento Kings 107-103 on Friday night for their sixth straight win.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dante Exum hits late 3-pointer, Kyrie Irving scores 30 in Mavericks' 107-103 win over Kings

events.name: Boston Celtics at New Orleans Pelicans

headlines.description: — Jayson Tatum scored 23 points and the Boston Celtics rebounded from back-to-back losses to Atlanta, pulling away in the third quarter for a 104-92 win over the New Orleans Pelicans on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Tatum scores 23 as Celtics rebound from back-to-back losses with 104-92 win over Pelicans

headlines.description: — Wendell Carter Jr. had 15 points and 13 rebounds, Jalen Suggs and Cole Anthony added 15 points each and the Orlando Magic broke a three-game losing streak with a 118-88 rout of the Memphis Grizzlies on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Orlando Magic snap 3-game skid with 118-88 rout of Memphis Grizzlies

headlines.description: — Giannis Antetokounmpo had six dunks while scoring 36 points and the Milwaukee Bucks overcame Bogdan Bogdanovic's 38 points to beat Atlanta 122-113 on Saturday night, ending the Hawks' four-game winning streak.
headlines.shortLinkText: Giannis Antetokounmpo has 36 points, 16 rebounds to power Bucks past Hawks, 122-113

headlines.description: — Nikola Jokic had 26 points, 18 rebounds and 16 assists for his 22nd triple-double of the season, and the Denver Nuggets beat the Cleveland Cavaliers 130-101 on Sunday to clinch a playoff berth.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jokic has 26 points, 18 rebounds and 16 assists to lead Nuggets over Cavs, 130-101

events.name: Los Angeles Lakers at Brooklyn Nets

headlines.description: — LeBron James would only hint at how long he expects to keep playing NBA basketball.
headlines.shortLinkText: LeBron James ties career high with 9 3-pointers, scores 40 points as Lakers beat Nets 116-104

headlines.description: — Paul George knocked down eight 3-pointers and finished with a season-high 41 points, and the Los Angeles Clippers defeated the Charlotte Hornets 130-118 on Sunday night for their fifth straight road win.
headlines.shortLinkText: Paul George pours in 41 points as Clippers continue dominance of Hornets with 130-118 victory

headlines.description: — Kelly Oubre Jr. scored a season-high 32 points, Kyle Lowry had 11 points and 10 assists against his former team and the Philadelphia 76ers snapped a three-game losing streak, beating the Toronto Raptors 135-120 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kelly Oubre Jr. scores season-high 32 points, 76ers beat Raptors 135-120 to end 3-game skid

headlines.description: — Terry Rozier III scored 27 points, Bam Adebayo had 22 and the Miami Heat grinded out a 119-107 victory over the Washington Wizards on Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rozier, Adebayo help Heat outlast Wizards, move closer to sixth-place Indiana

events.name: Oklahoma City Thunder at New York Knicks

headlines.description: — Shai Gilgeous-Alexander made the go-ahead jumper from the corner with 2.6 seconds left, sending the Oklahoma City Thunder to the playoffs for the first time since 2020 with a 113-112 victory over the New York Knicks on Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Thunder clinch first playoff spot since 2020, beat Knicks on Gilgeous-Alexander's jumper

headlines.description: — Luka Doncic had 47 points, 12 rebounds and seven assists, Kyrie Irving added 24 points and seven assists, and the Dallas Mavericks won their seventh straight and snapped the Houston Rockets’ 11-game winning streak with a 125-107 victory on Sunday...
headlines.shortLinkText: Doncic scores 47 as Mavericks win seventh straight and end Rockets' 11-game win streak

headlines.description: — DeMar DeRozan had 27 points and eight assists and Alex Caruso added 21 points on a season-high seven 3-pointers as the hot-shooting Chicago Bulls beat the Minnesota Timberwolves 109-101 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: DeRozan, Caruso light it up as Bulls knock off Timberwolves 109-101

events.name: Golden State Warriors at San Antonio Spurs

headlines.description: — Stephen Curry had 33 points and the Golden State Warriors held on to beat the undermanned San Antonio Spurs 117-113 on Sunday night for their fourth straight victory.
headlines.shortLinkText: Curry scores 33 points, Warriors overcome Wembanyama, Spurs for 4th straight win

headlines.description: — Harrison Barnes scored 24 points and keyed a big third-quarter run for Sacramento that carried the Kings to a 127-106 victory over the Utah Jazz on Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Harrison Barnes keys big 3rd quarter that carries the Kings past the Jazz 127-106
